title: Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African dish, Algerian lamb kebabs are a perfect blend of spices, herbs, and tender lamb. Serve with couscous or bread for a hearty meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Algerian spice blend, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and mix until coated with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb pieces onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Brush the kebabs with additional olive oil during the last minute of grilling.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve hot with couscous or bread.
